title: Uber罕见大裁员：3300人离开，管理层砍两成
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Carmen, while we have you, it would also be great to get into what we heard from Uber this morning.
segments.zh: 卡门，趁你在，我们也很想聊聊今早Uber的消息。

segments.en: It's an interesting one, because we remember at the start of this year, Uber was doing their token maxing. They blew through their entire year's budget of tokens in just a few months,
segments.zh: 这挺有意思，因为记得今年年初，Uber在大力推广代币，几个月就花承压全年预算。

segments.en: so we know Uber has been spending, and in some cases spending a lot. On AI, they announced this morning, we learned this morning, the Bloomberg team, that they're cutting 3,300 jobs,
segments.zh: 我们知道Uber一直在花钱，有时花得很多。今早彭博团队获悉，他们宣布裁员3300人。

segments.en: about 10% of their workforce. What does this tell us about where their priorities are, about where capital is being allocated into Uber?
segments.zh: 约占员工总数的10%。这告诉我们他们的优先事项是什么，资本如何配置到Uber？

segments.en: Well, it looks like they really are trimming jobs here, sort of cutting out maybe some middle managers and moving people back into individual
segments.zh: 看起来他们确实在精简岗位，可能裁掉一些中层管理者，让员工回归个人贡献者角色。

segments.en: contributor roles to free up some spending and make sure that they're able to reallocate into ride sharing delivery and their robotaxi businesses. This is significant. It's also saying,
segments.zh: 以释放开支，确保能重新分配到拼车、配送和无人驾驶出租车业务。这很重要。

segments.en: I think it's important to point out that Uber hadn't had the same job cut trend that maybe
segments.zh: 需要指出的是，Uber此前并未像其他科技公司那样出现裁员趋势。

segments.en: a lot of other tech companies have seen. They've, I guess, stayed pretty consistent since the pandemic. This is a pretty big cut for them. It's about 10% of its staff, and it's also going to be
segments.zh: 自疫情以来，他们一直保持稳定。这次裁员规模相当大，约占员工10%，还涉及约20%的管理层。

segments.en: about 20% of managers. Definitely interesting to see where this company is pivoting to make sure that they're allocating spend and sort of where they're cutting from. The stock is
segments.zh: 看看这家公司如何调整以确保支出分配，以及从哪里削减，确实很有趣。股价反应积极。

segments.en: reacted positively. It's up a little bit this morning. I think it's still down on the year, but getting some buying from investors on this news.
segments.zh: 今早略有上涨，今年仍下跌，但市场参与者对这一消息有所买入。
